Fca Has Boosted Apple (AAPL) Stake by $396,305; Oaktree Capital Management LP Has Lowered Its Taiwan Semi. (TSM) Stake by $18.76 Million 
April 21, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Fca Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 131.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fca Corp bought 2,345 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,128 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $699,000, up from 1,783 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fca Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.87 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26 million shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Howard Marks decreased its stake in Taiwan Semi. (TSM) by 11.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oaktree Capital Management Lp sold 481,144 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.24% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Howard Marks held 3.57 million shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $141.41M, down from 4.05M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oaktree Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Taiwan Semi. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $198.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.47% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $38.95. About 15.31M shares traded or 99.54% up from the average. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 30.51% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.96% the S&P500. 
Oaktree Capital Management Lp, which manages about $6.38 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Oasis Petroleum Inc (Prn) by 6.11 million shares to 16.11M shares, valued at $17.35M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Allscripts Healthcare Solutions Inc (Prn) by 5.75M shares in the quarter, for a total of 35.23M shares, and has risen its stake in Brookdale Senior Living Inc (Prn).
